newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Schlumberger EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Schlumberger EPS view raised.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter said it raised its 1997 earnings estimates on Schlumberger Ltd to $4.95 a share from $4.60 a share.
-- said expects the company to earn $6.40 a share in 1998.
-- set a six month price target of $145 a share.
-- said Schlumberger is one of the largest and most profitable offshore drilling companies in the world.
--said over the last year, profitability at the Geco-Prakla division "has improved measurably."
-- said the pace of technological innovation at Schlumberger remains robust across all oilfield divisions.
